==Active Ability: Time Acceleration==
[[File:TimeAccelerationIcon.png|thumb|left]]
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' decreases the SPA of all units in the map for the duration when used.
* SPA Decrease: 50%
* Duration: 30 Seconds
* Global Cooldown: 300 Seconds


Note that this does not stack with [[Trickster (Release)|Trickster]]'s ability (only the SPA part). However, this boost doesn't work on units whose SPA is lower than their actual attack animation.
==Selling==
Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

==Trivia==

* Priest (Heaven)'s shiny skin could possibly be based on the video "[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5t59Sr9hw7A&ab_channel=Vehgeto Made In Heaven Test Animation]" by Vehgeto as they both similarly share the same Black & White artstyle.
* All of his upgrade costs are prime numbers, befitting the character's personality.
** As a result, his cost in high cost contracts and challenges contains a decimal.
*From update 19.0, he has received a 100% damage buff, increasing his overall damage.
